_about: Model-specific failure-only punchlines, never completion roasts.
_license: Original to Print Handy; AGPL-3.0-only with the project.

benchy.text: The Titanic would like to thank you for taking the pressure off its reputation.
That ship went down before the launch ceremony.
The maritime accident report is going to be shorter than the slicer settings.

cube.text: Geometry has issued a formal complaint about the unauthorized addition of extra faces.
Six sides was apparently an unreasonable number of deliverables.
Euclid has requested that this evidence be destroyed.

dragon.text: Smaug would burn the evidence before anybody could see this.
The dragon went extinct before it finished evolving.
The fantasy kingdom has canceled its air force procurement contract.

phone stand.text: Your phone has been advised to seek emergency accommodation elsewhere.
The desk has resumed providing the service for free.
The phone's new housing development has collapsed before occupancy.

gear.text: The industrial revolution has been postponed due to a problem with one tooth.
The gear has discovered that unemployment is easier than transferring torque.
The mechanism has filed for divorce on grounds of irreconcilable tolerances.

bracket.text: The wall has revoked the bracket's building permit.
Gravity has won the structural engineering argument before installation even started.
The bracket has been declared unfit for holding even its own reputation.

organizer.text: The mess has successfully defeated the department established to eliminate it.
The storage project has produced another thing that needs to be disposed of.
The junk drawer has won the war on urban planning.

planter.text: The plant has been notified that its apartment failed inspection.
The landlord has lost the building before collecting the first month's rent.
Photosynthesis has been postponed due to a construction defect.

vase.text: The flowers are now accepting condolences instead of water.
The museum has withdrawn the exhibit before the opening ceremony.
The pottery department has requested a refund on the concept of a container.

helmet.text: The helmet failed its first encounter with absolutely no combat.
The safety inspector has declined to wear the evidence.
The knight will be attending the battle in business casual.

octopus.text: Eight arms were apparently seven more than the printer could manage.
The octopus has become a maritime search and rescue operation.
Poseidon has rejected the creature's application for aquatic life.

dino.text: The dinosaur has undergone a second and significantly less interesting extinction.
Jurassic Park has pulled the plug on the cloning program.
The fossil record has declined to include this specimen.

robot.text: The robot uprising has been delayed by a manufacturing defect.
Skynet has officially canceled the hardware contract.
The robot failed before it could even threaten an unoccupied desk.

rocket.text: Mission control has lost contact before liftoff.
NASA would classify this as a very small crater in the research budget.
The countdown has been replaced with a procurement investigation.

lightsaber.text: The Jedi Council has downgraded this weapon to an administrative incident.
The Force has declined to intervene in the failed manufacturing process.
The Sith have lost the arms race to a heated bed.

curiosity rover.text: The rover couldn't survive Earth, which makes the Mars mission a little ambitious.
Mission control has stopped searching for signs of intelligent design.
NASA would like its launch vehicle back before you touch anything else.

eiffel tower.text: Paris has requested that you leave urban planning to the French.
The tower has encountered an unexpected horizontal career opportunity.
The tourism board has canceled the ribbon cutting.

gyroid.text: The topology has achieved a new and thoroughly unwanted mathematical singularity.
The infill has discovered an alternative geometry called none of the above.
The mathematician has withdrawn the proof pending a review of the physical evidence.

mammoth.text: The Ice Age has claimed another victim without needing to show up.
The Smithsonian has rejected the fossil before it could enter the fossil record.
The extinction event was remarkably localized to one build plate.

jukebox.text: The jukebox has been silenced before it could play its first questionable record.
The diner has canceled its grand reopening due to an equipment catastrophe.
The music industry has lost absolutely nothing of cultural significance.

church bell.text: The bell tolls for the filament budget, which will not be resurrected.
The congregation has declared the print beyond divine intervention.
The church has canceled the dedication and scheduled a cleanup instead.

marionette.text: The puppet has lost the plot before the curtain went up.
The theater has replaced the performance with a brief announcement about technical difficulties.
The strings were apparently not the only thing holding the production together.

elf.text: Santa has terminated the subcontractor responsible for this particular holiday disaster.
The elf on the shelf has been relocated to the bin.
The North Pole has issued a recall before Christmas even started.

cat.text: The cat has used up one of its nine lives before leaving the printer.
Even Schrodinger wouldn't bother opening this box.
The feline has declined to land on its feet.

dog.text: The obedience school has expelled the dog before orientation.
The dog has been returned to the shelter for a structural problem.
The mailman remains undefeated despite having done absolutely nothing.

gridfinity.text: The zoning board has condemned the development before the first tool could move in.
The grid has achieved neither order nor infinity, an ambitious double failure.
The hex keys have been told to remain homeless until further notice.

cable.text: The cables have survived yet another attempt to organize them.
The wiring closet has declined to accept this settlement proposal.
The infrastructure project has run out of structural integrity before it ran out of money.

hinge.text: The relationship ended before either party got to change its mind.
The door has retained its independence from the engineering department.
The hinge's limited range of motion has been reduced to zero.

sword.text: The king has returned the weapon to the stone for warranty service.
The battle has been canceled because the sword failed to survive peacetime.
The blacksmith's apprentice has been reassigned to sweeping the floor.

dice.text: The dice have discovered a new outcome outside the range of acceptable probabilities.
The dungeon master has ruled that the manufacturer failed its saving throw.
The casino has returned the equipment before the first losing bet.
